summary: Windows modules must be developed and tested on Windows hosts; the easiest setup is a Vagrant VM in VirtualBox using packer-windoze boxes from Vagrant Cloud.
questions: What's the easiest way to get a Windows test host for module development?
What do I need installed to set up a Windows dev VM?

answer_card.title: Windows dev environment
answer_card.answer_md: Windows modules must be tested on Windows. The simplest route is a **Vagrant** VM on **VirtualBox** using the packer-windoze boxes on Vagrant Cloud. Install Vagrant and VirtualBox first; evaluation images from Microsoft usually need extra setup.
